source.title: PRHYDE Protocol for Heavy-Duty Hydrogen Refuelling

access_observation.reported_campaign_scope: ZBT and Nikola tank campaigns; four instrumented tanks; reports describe 2 Hz PLC logging and pressure, temperature and mass-flow channels
access_observation.observation: The public PRHYDE page exposes reports and presentations. The reports describe experimental campaigns and results, but the project page does not link a raw CSV/Excel time-series archive or reuse terms for the underlying logger export.
